description: LOWELL, Mass. (Nov. 20, 2019) – Democrat Lori Trahan proudly announces the endorsement of the Professional Fire Fighters of Massachusetts in her re-election bid for Congress in Massachusetts Third District. title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
